summary_rationale: Mondelēz International earns a COMPOUNDER_PASS with PASS_WITH_WATCH KPI health on a strictly price-blind basis. Its core moat rests on global category leadership in Biscuits & Baked Snacks (47.7% of FY2025 revenue; Oreo, Ritz, LU, Clif Bar) and Chocolate (32.9%; Cadbury Dairy Milk, Milka, Toblerone), generating $38.54 billion in FY2025 revenue across 150+ countries with no single customer exceeding 10% of sales and ~40% revenue exposure to higher-growth emerging markets (5M+ outlets in India, 1M+ stores in Brazil). Despite a historic 365% cocoa spike that compressed FY2025 GAAP gross margin by 1,070 bps to 28.4% and GAAP operating margin to 9.2%, cash generation remained resilient ($4.51B CFO, $3.24B FCF), and Q3 2026 demonstrated a clear operational inflection (+1.8 pp positive volume/mix, +380 bps YoY Adjusted Gross Margin expansion to 34.2%, and ~65% of revenue holding or gaining share). Watchpoints remain: sluggish North American biscuit volumes, European private-label elasticity, $43.96B of goodwill/intangibles (61.5% of assets) capping headline ROIC, and $19.08B net debt after FY2025 capital returns ($4.87B) exceeded FCF.
